records.text: Owens said people apparently found purchases through Erika Kirk’s Alo account the day after Charlie Kirk died, “like the morning after he died or something.”
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I now wish that Erica (Erika Kirk) had sort of left the story alone and left it to die. But apparently people found that she made purchases at Alo through her Alo accounts the day after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) died, like the morning after he died or something.

records.text: Owens recalled Elizabeth McCoy writing a thread saying she was the person who went to Alo because nobody had clothes; this is Owens’s characterization of that thread.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And then I thought that was nearly confirmed because Elizabeth McCoy did this long thread and answered and said, I'm the one who went to Alo. Nobody had any clothes or whatever. And again, my assumption was that Erica (Erika Kirk) was in a hysterical state.

records.text: Molot reported that the next morning Erika Kirk sent a Turning Point staff member to Alo Yoga for plain black clothes for herself and several others, including a young woman who had vomited from trauma.
records.speaker: Clara Molot

appearances.snippet: So the next morning she had a turning point staff member go to Alo Yoga to buy plain black clothes for her and several others, including one young woman who vomited on herself from the trauma.

conveyance.original_source: Vanity Fair, The Widow’s Peak, as read in Candace Ep 395
